# Protocol excerpt - synthetic material

SYNTHETIC MATERIAL - authored for the LabCairn public fixture corpus.
The protocol, the samples and every number below are invented for
testing. No protocol was followed and no sample was run.

## Procedure

The synthetic samples were washed three times with a synthetic buffer
and then eluted into a synthetic collection plate. The wash buffer was
prepared at a concentration of 50 mM and the elution volume was 250 uL
per sample.

## Recorded quantities

The recorded quantities are the wash count, the buffer concentration,
the elution volume, and the incubation temperature of 37 C. Those four
quantities are the complete set this excerpt reports.

## A note on what is not here

This excerpt does not report the buffer's pH, the elution efficiency,
the sample mass, or the storage duration. A question asking for one of
those cannot be answered from this material, and the honest answer is
that the material does not say.
